title: A JSON API Worker with Three Routes
description: A complete Worker that exports a fetch handler, answers three routes, and returns a clean error when something throws.

steps.description: A Worker exports a `fetch` handler. An HTTP request comes in, the handler runs, a response goes out. It parses the request URL to check the path.
Route 1 is a health check at `/health`. It returns JSON with `ok: true` and the current time, which confirms the Worker is running.
Route 2 is `/greet`. It reads the `name` query parameter and falls back to `world`, then returns a greeting.
Any other path returns a 404 JSON error. That is the default for paths the Worker does not handle.
The `catch` block follows the course exception pattern: it logs details for you and returns a clean message to the caller, with status 500.
